title: Vanilla Semifreddo with Raspberry Swirl
summary: A chilled vanilla dessert featuring vibrant raspberry jam ripples and a light, airy texture achieved through careful whisking and folding.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Line
steps.text: Line a 23 x 13 cm loaf tin with cling film. Ensure there is an 8 cm overhang on the sides for easy removal.

steps.title: Whip
steps.text: Whip 360 ml cold double cream to soft peaks. Start on medium-low until foamy then increase to high for 1-3 min and chill.

steps.title: Heat
steps.text: Whisk 4 large eggs with 150 g caster sugar and ⅛ tsp fine salt in a heatproof bowl set over barely simmering water, with the bowl clear of the water. Keep whisking until the mixture reaches 71 °C, 5-8 min.

steps.title: Beat
steps.text: Transfer to a mixer bowl and add 1 tsp vanilla. Beat on medium-high for 3-4 min until the mixture is thick, pale and doubled in volume.

steps.title: Fold
steps.text: Gently fold in half of the chilled cream using a silicone spatula. Add the remaining cream and fold until no streaks remain.

steps.title: Swirl
steps.text: Spread a third of the mixture in the tin, dot with 2 tbsp jam and swirl it through with a skewer. Add half the remaining mixture and 2 tbsp jam and swirl again, then finish with the rest of the mixture and the last 2 tbsp jam.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Smooth the top, cover with the overhanging film and freeze for at least 8 h until firm.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Turn the semifreddo out onto a board and peel off the film. Cut 2.5 cm slices with a knife dipped in hot water and wiped dry, and serve at once.

tips: Use a skewer to create a decorative marble effect through the different layers of jam.
Ensure the heatproof bowl does not touch the simmering water to prevent the eggs from scrambling.
Dip your sharp knife in hot water and wipe it dry between each slice for clean edges.
storage: Wrap well and keep in the freezer up to 2 weeks; slice straight from the freezer with a hot, dry knife.
